headline: Zelenskyy says Starlink degraded, intel sharing disrupted, Patriots held
dek: After a bipartisan video call with Zelenskyy, senators stated: critical Starlink/Starshield services remain degraded (speed caps ~160 km/h, dropping at 60-80 km/h per RBC-Ukraine sources); Ukraine missed US ballistic-missile early warnings on three occasions; Hegseth is not approving Patriot…
sources: U.S. Senators Richard Blumenthal (D-CT) and Thom Tillis (R-NC) — official readout on blumenthal.senate.gov; enriched by enmnews (transcript from Ukrainian officials) and RBC-Ukraine
fault_line: Is Washington squeezing Kyiv to force a deal — or quietly switching sides?

sections.what_happened: After a bipartisan video call with Zelenskyy, senators stated: critical Starlink/Starshield services remain degraded (speed caps ~160 km/h, dropping at 60-80 km/h per RBC-Ukraine sources); Ukraine missed US ballistic-missile early warnings on three occasions; Hegseth is not approving Patriot interceptor and AIM-9X deliveries despite NATO countries having paid; administration waived congressionally-approved Russia sanctions. Zelenskyy proposed a 30-day mutual refinery-strike pause in exchange for Patriots — Witkoff and Kushner 'did not show interest' (enmnews). Zelenskyy: 'some political decision has been made to slow down support for us.'
sections.what_verified: Primary source = senators' official readout; AA independently reported the call; RBC-Ukraine gave technical detail; Zelenskyy said the same on NBC Meet the Press (Oct 18); intel restored Oct 18 per Zelenskyy (EA WorldView).
sections.what_disputed: Rubio rejected claims of deliberate restriction; Pentagon denied changing intel-sharing policy; Trump: administration still sharing intel, 'I don't know who did it, but I would like to find out' (APA, Oct 20 in-window); Bessent urged Zelenskyy to be cautious with accusations; Reuters Oct 15 cited officials saying instruction went White House->Pentagon; Telegraph: Musk advised Trump to slow terminals — mutually contradictory explanations, none fully confirmed.
sections.why_matters: Truth side: present Zelenskyy's own words and the senators' readout as the verified core; present the administration denials as the counterpoint with equal honesty. Map card: what was cut, for how long, what Trump said. The diesel-deal pocketbook thread (Tier 1) connects.
sections.context: Background: Bipartisan senators' readout: Zelenskyy says Starlink degraded, intel sharing disrupted, Patriots held — Congress vs administration split
